Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building age, size, classrooms, and specialized spaces; detailed condition assessments across major systems with cost estimates and prioritization (Sections 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Includes historic enrollment data and basic capacity information by site and classroom counts, but lacks detailed long-term projections, demographic analysis, or explicit connection to facility actions (Section 3).

Educational Alignment.justification: Mission statements and educational goals are referenced broadly; however, there is limited connection between educational programs and specific facility projects or detailed educational specifications (Sections 1, 6, 8).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Plan identifies outdoor spaces and includes strategies such as shade structures, landscaping with drought-tolerant plants, and playground improvements; some site-level details but no districtwide greening data (Sections 7, 9, 12).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges some climate-related strategies such as shade structures and drought-tolerant landscaping but lacks comprehensive climate risk assessment or districtwide climate resilience planning (Sections 7, 9, 12).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency upgrades like LED lighting, HVAC improvements, and security system upgrades; references some energy resilience goals but lacks comprehensive data or full integration with state mandates (Sections 9, 11, 12).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed cost estimates with classifications and priorities, discusses multiple funding sources including state programs, bonds, developer fees, and alternative financing; includes prioritization framework and long-term financial considerations (Sections 2, 3, 13, 14, 15).
